import { Body, Headers, HttpMethod } from trb/http
import { Context, Next, Request, Response } from trb/web
import { Timeout, TimeoutOptions } from trb/web/middleware/timeout

class Work implements Next
  @slow: Boolean
  def initialize(slow: Boolean)
    @slow = slow
    return
  end
  def call(_context: Context): Response
    if @slow
      mut index := 0
      while index < 1000000000
        index += 1
      end
    end
    return Response.text("complete")
  end
end

def context(): Context
  request := Request.new(method: HttpMethod.get(), path: "/", query_string: "", headers: Headers.new([]), body: Body.empty())
  return Context.new(request: request, path_parameters: {})
end

def main()
response := Timeout.call(context(), Work.new(false), TimeoutOptions.new(milliseconds: 1000))
puts(response.status)
puts(response.body.to_s())
end

import trb/std/file
import trb/std/path
import trb/std/result
class Work implements Next
  def call(_context: Context): Response
    value := File.open(Path.new("resource.txt")) do |file|
      text := try file.read_text(max_bytes: 64)
      puts("opened:" + text)

      7
    end
    case value
    when Result::Ok(value)
      puts("value:" + value.to_s())
    when Result::Err(error)
      puts("error:" + error.message)
    end
    return Response.text("complete")
  end
end

def main()
response := Timeout.call(context(), Work.new(), TimeoutOptions.new(milliseconds: 1000))
puts(response.status)
puts(response.body.to_s())
puts("inspect")
hold()
end

def hold()
limit := Instant.now().add(Duration.seconds(2))
while Instant.now().before?(limit)
nil
end
end

import { OidcBearerOptions } from trb/auth/oidc
import { Body, Header, Headers, HttpMethod } from trb/http
import { Context, Next, Request, Response } from trb/web
import { Timeout, TimeoutOptions } from trb/web/middleware/timeout
import trb/web/auth/bearer
import trb/std/process
import { Duration, Instant } from trb/std/time

class Reply implements Next
  def call(_context: Context): Response
    return Response.text("accepted")
  end
end

class Foreign implements Next
  @options: OidcBearerOptions
  def initialize(issuer: String)
    @options = OidcBearerOptions.new(issuer: issuer, audience: "api", jwks_uri: issuer + "/slow", roles_claim: "roles", clock_skew_seconds: 0)
    return
  end
  def call(context: Context): Response
    puts("foreign-start")
    return Bearer.authenticate(context, Reply.new(), @options)
  end
end

def hold(milliseconds: Integer)
  deadline := Instant.now().add(Duration.milliseconds(milliseconds))
  while Instant.now().before?(deadline)
    nil
  end
end

def main()
  args := Process.argv()
  request := Request.new(method: HttpMethod.get(), path: "/", query_string: "",
    headers: Headers.new([Header.new(name: "Authorization", value: "Bearer " + args[1])]), body: Body.empty())
  context := Context.new(request: request, path_parameters: {})
  response := Timeout.call(context, Foreign.new(args[0]), TimeoutOptions.new(milliseconds: 100))
  puts(response.status)
  puts("after-response")
  hold(6000)
  puts("after-wait")
  hold(1000)
end

expected.watchdogPurpose: distinguish deadline response from the independent five-second OIDC timeout; not a public latency SLO
